_note: Face crops for the round portraits on tree cards. 'person' is matched like a story link: 'Name' or 'Name (birth year)'. 'face' is the centre of the face as fractions of the photo's width and height; 'size' is the side of the square crop as a fraction of the photo's width. A photo named here is also added to that person's photos. People presumed living never get a portrait. A person with no entry gets an automatic crop only when they are the only person linked to a photo.
